short: A pioneering ironclad of the United States Navy, distinguished by its rotating gun turret.
full:
Designed by the Swedish-American engineer John Ericsson and launched in 1862, the USS Monitor was a radical departure from traditional warship design. She featured a low freeboard, heavy iron plating, and a revolutionary rotating armoured turret mounting two massive Dahlgren guns. Her low profile presented an incredibly difficult target for enemy artillery.

In March 1862, she engaged the Confederate ironclad CSS Virginia at the Battle of Hampton Roads. Their historic clash was the first battle between ironclad warships, signalling the end of the wooden naval era. The Monitor sank later that same year during a heavy storm off Cape Hatteras.
